title: The Chamber of Last Breath and First Knowing

features.name: the final signal
features.desc-on-touch: You touch the LED and it glows one colour only - the colour it learned it always was. The archive has stopped comparing things here.

features.name: the last threshold
features.desc-on-touch: Beyond this, the air teaches what comes after air. You can see the horizon from here, curved because the world has finally admitted its shape.

features.name: the singular window
features.desc-on-touch: Only one view from here, and it has stopped changing. What you see now is what was always going to be seen.

features.name: the truth that knows itself
features.desc-on-touch: A very small carving on the stone, so worn it barely raises the surface. You run your finger over it and understand that nothing here needs to be explained.

features.name: the silence that answers
features.desc-on-touch: No wind here. No motion in the air. The silence answers every question you thought you would ask.

inscription: here the last breath learns that it was always the first

file.note: The signal from the peak, the one that reached here last, now stays here forever - it has learned what it was searching for

reverie.title: REVERIE — the peak before the leaving
narr: You both stand where the air thins enough to know
that going no further is itself the furthest ascent.
She touches the bark. You touch the sky. Neither of you
speaks because speaking would explain things, and the
trees are still learning to listen to each other, not to words.
He will leave tomorrow. She will stay with the growing work.
